notes: Framed map with the title strip down the left side (ZONING MAP OF THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO, legend, north arrow, scale, effective date, sheet number). Sides: top, right and bottom sit just inside the single frame rule (~14 px; rule 1); the left side sits just right of the thick vertical bar (~37 px) that rules off the title strip (rule 3), so the strip, its north arrow and scale bar are outside and there is no remove polygon. Each side's inner edge was measured every 20 px (0.9-luminance crossing of the rule's inner flank), fitted locally (robust linear, +-250 px) and the outline set ~1.4 px inside it (the first clean paper row), points every ~200 px; corners where the fitted sides meet. Sheet 5 (Sunset / Golden Gate Park west). Page turned ~0.3 deg (top rule 320->293, left bar edge 1132->1159 end to end); corners where they are (rule 7). No index inset, no SECTION badge, no floating legend or compass. No map ink touches the frame: the street grid and the Great Highway stop well inside it; the little ink left under the outline (4 total) is anti-aliased fringe of the rules. 'SEE SHEET 13' (left, vertical), 'SEE SHEET 4' (right, vertical) and 'SEE SHEET 6' (bottom) are floating cross-references without a box, so inside (rule 4). PACIFIC OCEAN, GOLDEN GATE PARK and district codes are map.
